name: verify nix settings eval
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && nix eval --impure --json .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.nix.settings --apply 's: { inherit (s) max-jobs cores max-substitution-jobs substituters; }' 2>&1 | tail -3 && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.programs.nh.clean.extraArgs 2>&1 | tail -1 && nix eval --impure .#nixosConfigurations.ASAHI.config.nix.settings.max-jobs 2>&1 | tail -1
